title: Configuration acceptance bit
statement: For a configuration of a Turing machine with Boolean output symbols, define its acceptance bit to be true exactly when the majority value of its output string is true.
caveat: The snippet does not include the definition of the majority operation on output strings, so its convention, including how ties are handled, is unavailable.
